author: Alexis R. Ware
html:
“””Excellent read! This blog serves as a complete guide on how to develop GenAI applications with Java based in Spring AI framework. It covers how to integrate LLMs (like OpenAI) with a Neo4j vector database to enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). If you’re a Java developer who is interested in working with generative AI, its step-by-step instructions, project set-up outlines, code snippets and example ran outputs will be of great help.
If you want to explore more about Big Spring AI: https://mobisoftinfotech.com/resources/blog/ai-development/spring-ai-llm-integration-spring-boot“””
